cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Loading, healthy empty, partial and failed reads
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Only a successful complete current read may say none/all clear. Show useful recovery for timeout and partial source; no private sample/old data as current.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Offline, reconnecting, hidden/paused and stale data
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Explain connection/age and suspend decisions; re-read on return. Clear protected content as existing controls require; no phantom success.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Session ended, role/scope revoked, disabled module
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Remove unauthorized navigation and private content; direct routes/actions enforce current gates, explain unavailable capability and offer legitimate sign-in/recovery.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Draft, published, historical and superseded sources
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Label current revision/context; history is never editable as the current record. Source change invalidates exact-revision review where required.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Validation, missing data and eligibility
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Name the field/reason and how to fix it; distinguish missing/unset from a confirmed zero. Keep entered values and correct focus; server validates all rules.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Pending, confirmed success and partial batch result
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Disable duplicate submission, show actual action identity and truthful receipt, exact target/date/scope and next step; each batch outcome stays visible.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Unknown result, retry and status lookup
cross_cutting_acceptance.applies_to: Requests, copies, corrections, exports, payroll, invitations/device changes
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Preserve the original operation identity and reconcile; do not start another operation or infer failure from timeout. Avoid showing sample Undo when source has no authorized reversal.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Back, deep link and interrupted work
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Carry exact date/week/location/person/filter/item and safe origin; preserve search/scroll and unsaved entries; return focus near meaningful content; handle vanished/already-decided targets.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Small phones, text enlargement and mobile input
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Complete labels/values, reachable controls above safe area/keyboard, consistent touch targets; native time/date/select/file pickers, long names and translated content.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Keyboard, screen reader, reduced motion and meaning
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Visible focus and correct names/order, trapped modal/restored focus, announced errors/receipts, status beyond color and reduced motion; actual assistive-tech testing pending.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Sensitive and consequential actions
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Clear person/scope and actual consequence before confirmation; privacy and transient-code cleanup; permissions remain explicit; no real messages/money/data mutations in tests without authorization.

cross_cutting_acceptance.title: Integration, device and permission verification
cross_cutting_acceptance.required: Use isolated test fixtures and approved references; verify real server guards, conflicts and network states, mobile browsers/devices and downloads. Prior mockup test passes do not certify these workflows.
